title: Truchas 2D scalar function value
description: A scalar-function value accepted by 2D input parameters. A value may be a real number or an inline scalar-function definition.

number-array.description: A non-empty array of real numbers.

integer-array-or-matrix.description: A vector of integer exponents for a one-variable polynomial, or a JSON array of exponent vectors for a multivariable polynomial. In the notation f(x) = sum_j c_j product_i (x_i - x0_i)^(a_ij), i identifies an independent variable and j identifies a polynomial term.

items.description: One exponent per independent variable for one polynomial term.

oneOf.description: The outer array is indexed by term j and contains one inner array per term. The inner array is indexed by variable i, so poly-powers[j][i] is the exponent a_ij.

constant.title: Constant function
constant.description: A scalar function with the same value for every input.

polynomial.title: Polynomial function
polynomial.description: A one-variable or multivariable polynomial defined by coefficient and exponent arrays.

poly-coef.description: Coefficient c_j for each polynomial term j. The number of coefficients must match the number of entries in a one-variable exponent vector or the number of inner arrays in a multivariable poly-powers value.

poly-powers.description: Integer exponents a_ij for the polynomial terms. For multiple variables, write one inner JSON array per term j, with one exponent for each variable i.

poly-center.description: Optional reference point x0_i at which polynomial coordinates are centered. Use a number for a one-variable polynomial or an array indexed by variable i for a multivariable polynomial; the default is zero.

tabular.title: Tabular function
tabular.description: A scalar function defined by paired tabular coordinates and values.

tabular x.description: At least two tabular input coordinates. The number of entries must match tabular y.

tabular y.description: Function values corresponding to tabular x. The number of entries must match tabular x.

smooth-ramp.title: Smooth ramp function
smooth-ramp.description: A smooth transition from a starting value to an ending value over a time interval.

type.description: Selects the smooth ramp function form.

begin time.description: Time at which the ramp has its beginning value.

begin value.description: Function value at or before begin time.

end time.description: Time at which the ramp has its ending value.

end value.description: Function value at or after end time.

library.title: Dynamically loaded function
library.description: A scalar function exported by a user-supplied shared library.

scalar-function-value.title: Scalar function value
scalar-function-value.description: A scalar function input may be a real number, which creates a constant function, or an object defining an inline scalar function.

scalar-property-value.title: Material property value
scalar-property-value.description: A material property value or attribute. Numbers and inline function objects define scalar property functions; booleans define material attributes.
